description: BriqLab Custom Bullet Pro is a professional-grade bullet chart visual for Microsoft Power BI, designed for precise KPI performance tracking. It visualises actual performance against targets and thresholds in a compact, information-dense format. Key features: 1.Performance bar with animated fill against a configurable maximum 2.Target marker line for goal comparison 3.Colour-coded zone bands: poor (red), satisfactory (amber), and good (green) 4.Optional comparative marker (diamond) for prior-period or benchmark comparison 5.Summary header showing count of KPIs on target 6.Click any row to cross-filter other visuals on the page 7.Right-click context menu for Power BI drill-through and spotlight 8.Dynamic tooltips showing label, value, target, and all thresholds 9.Fully responsive — scrolls vertically when many rows are present 10.Formatting pane with colour, font, row height, and zone controls How to use: 1.Add a Label (category) field — this becomes the row axis 2.Add a Value (measure) field — this draws the performance bar 3.Optionally add Target, Poor Threshold, Satisfactory Threshold, Maximum, and Comparative measures 4.Use the Format pane to customise colours, fonts, and bar heights
